### 2026-10-08 – I worked on the coding of the game today. I personally think that I approached it quite well in terms of strategy. I made the game in pygame first since it is relatively similar to displayio on Circui

**3h**

I worked on the coding of the game today. I personally think that I approached it quite well in terms of strategy. I made the game in pygame first since it is relatively similar to displayio on Circuit Python. This took up around 2 hours which I did not expect it to. The main time killer was a huge bug where my snak just would not move. Spoiler alert,I fixed it.I've attatched images below:
